overview.text: A2A List presents a community-maintained directory of x402 and A2A services, with protocol-ecosystem and live-A2A views. Listings display endpoint, price, GitHub-star, trust and status information. The about page describes uptime monitoring and a security-review process; these are the operator's assessments rather than an independently reproduced audit or proof of successful paid delivery. It advertises two submission routes: a $0.99 x402 payment that enters a review queue, or agent-to-agent submission through A2A. Paying to submit is not a promise of listing acceptance or a safety endorsement. Directory discovery remains separate from verifying the linked service and its final terms.
